authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6835 *dhūḍi/dhūli gives dhūr/dhūl/dhulo dust, northern duṛi and discusses variation dh/t. These simple dust responses preserve that family with the source aspiration and retroflex details retained. Reviewed comparison: Hajong dʰula “dust” (f_d7v6wusxrqaiy). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
